title: Qt: add reset layout button to toolbar

notes.body:
Can we use the same images as in Preferences -> Appearance -> Layout, and use the icon which matches the configured layout? The provided icon only show default layout, which may be misleading.

The provided icon doesn't have the same look and feel as the other icons, at least on macOS. Maybe use a gray color for the digits, or simply just remove the digits?

![Screenshot_2024-07-20_at_00.33.47](/uploads/e9a63285c1017d25cfc903fe538d2bf0/Screenshot_2024-07-20_at_00.33.47.png)

I used the art for "resize-columns" as a starting point.  
Changed the text to black to see if would look better on tiny windows symbol.  
Are the colors ok in `Preferences -> Appearance -> Layout`?  
  
If so I'll use their svg and export the sizes as needed.  
All 6 flavors if I can get the menu icon and toolbar icon to update when the preference is changed and on loading at startup.

I like the new icons, it's more clear what the button does with different layouts. Now of course I also want to be able to change the layout using this button, but that's a different story.

Very nit-pick, but the background color should be the same light gray as the other custom buttons (#EEEEEC vs #EFEFEF). Maybe it shows a bit whiter because it doesn't have the vertical lines, but the color is not exactly the same.

![Screenshot_2024-07-24_at_00.01.23](/uploads/dd12fc91c7711c3c6242d761859f010e/Screenshot_2024-07-24_at_00.01.23.png)

It's been "a great opportunity" to learn my way around inkscape. :smiley:   
It seems almost like the difference between the enabled and not enabled buttons but the button functions so that's not it. I'll chip away some more. Thanks for the feedback.

Better to have one `.svg` file but now buttons on `prefs->layout` background color changed?  
Or keep one file and add more objects with different fill color based on use.  
or  
Two `.svg` files - one for prefs and one for the toolbar button?  
Most other buttons have their own `.svg` so precedent.

https://lists.wireshark.org/archives/wireshark-dev/202407/msg00010.html  
> Aug  5 : Create the release-4.4 branch and switch the master branch version to 4.5  
  
I would like to get this into master for 4.4.
I don't have a strong opinion about the color change in preferences, as long as they still look good in both light and dark mode.

The best way to make it rain is to wash the car.  
I want to move along with the WSUG updates. Several days to update the colors if people find them annoying. Thanks!  
  
I really want to align the icon file names with the layout type in the preference so I will be visiting the files again.

+#!/bin/bash
+# layouts-to-png
+# Convert SVG files to 1x and 2x PNGs. Dump a list of Qt resource
+# file entries upon successful completion.
+#
+# Copyright 2014 Gerald Combs <gerald [AT] wireshark.org>
+#
+# Wireshark - Network traffic analyzer
+# By Gerald Combs <gerald@wireshark.org>
+# Copyright 1998 Gerald Combs
+#
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+
+# COMMON_ARGS="--export-area-page"
+
+#SVGCLEANER=$( type -p svgcleaner )
+
+# Running on WSL. Set as needed for Mac/linux.
+INKSCAPE_EXE="inkscape.com"
+
+ICONS="
+    layout_1
+    layout_2
+    layout_3
+    layout_4
+    layout_5
+    layout_6
+    "
+
+if [ -n "$*" ] ; then
+    ICONS="$*"
+fi
+
+QRC_FILES=""
+
+for SIZE in 16x16 24x24 ; do
+    WIDTH=${SIZE/x*/}
+    HEIGHT=${SIZE/*x/}
+    SIZE_DIR=${SIZE}
+
+    TWO_X_WIDTH=$(( WIDTH * 2 ))
+    TWO_X_HEIGHT=$(( HEIGHT * 2 ))
+    ONE_X_ARGS="--export-width=${WIDTH} --export-height=${HEIGHT}"
+    TWO_X_ARGS="--export-width=${TWO_X_WIDTH} --export-height=${TWO_X_HEIGHT}"
+
+    echo "Converting $SIZE_DIR"
+    cd $SIZE_DIR || exit 1
+
+    for ICON in $ICONS ; do
+        echo "Converting $ICON"
+
+        ONE_X_SVG="../../layouts.svg"
+        TWO_X_SVG=$ONE_X_SVG
+
+        ICONNAME="x-reset-$ICON"
+        ONE_X_PNG=${ICONNAME}.png
+        TWO_X_PNG=${ICONNAME}@2x.png
+
+        if [ "$ONE_X_SVG" -nt "$ONE_X_PNG" ] ; then
+            # shellcheck disable=SC2086
+            $INKSCAPE_EXE $COMMON_ARGS $ONE_X_ARGS --export-id="$ICON" \
+                --export-filename="$ONE_X_PNG" $ONE_X_SVG || exit 1
+            QRC_FILES="${QRC_FILES} ${SIZE_DIR}/${ONE_X_PNG}"
+        fi
+
+        if [ "$TWO_X_SVG" -nt "$TWO_X_PNG" ] ; then
+            # shellcheck disable=SC2086
+            $INKSCAPE_EXE $COMMON_ARGS $TWO_X_ARGS --export-id="$ICON" \
+                --export-filename="$TWO_X_PNG" $TWO_X_SVG || exit 1
+            QRC_FILES="${QRC_FILES} ${SIZE_DIR}/${TWO_X_PNG}"
+        fi
+
+    done
+
+    cd ..
+
+done
+
+for QRC_FILE in $QRC_FILES ; do
+    echo "        <file>stock_icons/${QRC_FILE}</file>"
+done
+
+echo "--------------------------------------"
+QRC_FILES=""
+
+for SIZE in 48x48 96x96 ; do
+    WIDTH=${SIZE/x*/}
+    HEIGHT=${SIZE/*x/}
+    OUT_DIR=".."
+
+    TWO_X_WIDTH=$(( WIDTH * 2 ))
+    TWO_X_HEIGHT=$(( HEIGHT * 2 ))
+    ONE_X_ARGS="--export-width=${WIDTH} --export-height=${HEIGHT}"
+    TWO_X_ARGS="--export-width=${TWO_X_WIDTH} --export-height=${TWO_X_HEIGHT}"
+
+    echo "Converting $OUT_DIR"
+
+    for ICON in $ICONS ; do
+        echo "Converting $ICON"
+
+        ONE_X_SVG=${OUT_DIR}/layouts.svg
+        TWO_X_SVG=$ONE_X_SVG
+
+        ICONNAME="$ICON"
+        ONE_X_PNG=${OUT_DIR}/${ICONNAME}.png
+        TWO_X_PNG=${OUT_DIR}/${ICONNAME}@2x.png
+
+        if [ "$ONE_X_SVG" -nt "$ONE_X_PNG" ] ; then
+            # shellcheck disable=SC2086
+            $INKSCAPE_EXE $COMMON_ARGS $ONE_X_ARGS --export-id="$ICON" \
+                --export-filename="$ONE_X_PNG" $ONE_X_SVG || exit 1
+            QRC_FILES="${QRC_FILES} ${ICONNAME}.png"
+        fi
+
+        if [ "$TWO_X_SVG" -nt "$TWO_X_PNG" ] ; then
+            # shellcheck disable=SC2086
+            $INKSCAPE_EXE $COMMON_ARGS $TWO_X_ARGS --export-id="$ICON" \
+                --export-filename="$TWO_X_PNG" $TWO_X_SVG || exit 1
+            QRC_FILES="${QRC_FILES} ${ICONNAME}@2x.png"
+        fi
+
+    done
+
+done
+
+for QRC_FILE in $QRC_FILES ; do
+    echo "        <file>${QRC_FILE}</file>"
+done
